svg.text: SPILLWAY — 5v5 defusal / LOS revision R05 — proposal
Meters · right-handed Z-up · north +Y · world origin (0,0) southwest · playable envelope 84 × 92 m within a 96 m design grid
Bridge section at X=49 m (looking west; Y horizontal)
Deck top Z=4; 0.30 m slab; underside Z=3.70
Lower mid passes below; no junction or ladder at crossing
Solid outline: 3 m boundary walls + 8–9 m building masses; open floor is walkable intent.
Dark blocks: full-height obstacles; pale blocks: 1.1 m low cover.
Orange: upper routes; filled ramp has no ground passage below.
U-N/U-SW/U-SE/U-W: 2.4 m upper screens. U-V: closed 2.4 m screen.
S-01/S-02: 4 m wide, 24-riser flights / 16 m run / 4 m rise.
R-01: 6 m wide ramp / 16 m run / 4 m rise (14° nominal).
Retired bay ray removed; predicted no through-screen view.
Review target 5v5; stress 2v2 and 1v2 post-plant. No respawns.
Source mapping / object dimensions: inventory.md. No playtest yet.

g.text: HEIGHT / FOV PLANNING — inspect these predictions before modeling
Ground: M-02 alternates with M-01; W-03/E-02 alternate with existing long-route baffles.
T-02/T-03 and CT-02/CT-03 break long transverse feed/gallery views. A-04/B-04 split key holds.
Blue building masses occupy existing inaccessible footprint holes; tops Z=8 or9 m, foundation Z=-0.3.
Keep upper crossing band Y=57.6..64.4 open between tall masses; 3.7 m soffit remains over mid.
Upper: close U-V to2.4 m; all stair/ramp side guards rise2.4 m above guide, end openings stay open.
U-B01/U-B02 alternate across deck, leaving2.2 m clear bypasses. U-LB separates landing approach views.
Existing IDs retained: M-01 width7m; W-01/E-01 width4.5m. New object dimensions in proposal.md.
Predicted occlusion only: no spawn-area rays; no view from bridge through tall buildings; verify heights after compile.
Height study: E–W section Y=56 m; XY origin shared; X right, Z up
X scale12px/m; Z scale16px/m. Eye projected from bridgeY61; exact visibility must use XYZ rays, not this section alone.
